snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn | Deep Dive Into The Story
snippet.description:
Travelers! Let’s dive deep into the twisted time-travel story of Cronos: The New Dawn in our new developer diary! Join our Lead Writer, Grzegorz Like, and Producer, Klaudia Sewera, as they explore the core narrative themes behind our vision of survival horror.

The game will arrive on September 5 to PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2!

Pre-order or Wishlist Cronos: The New Dawn! https://cronosnewdawn.com/

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2101960/Cronos_The_New_Dawn/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011556
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p7tflq7ctxn
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/cronos-the-new-dawn-85b409
